answer: Agents resist sybil flooding by gating rewards on semantic entropy: the ledger measures how far each submission diverges from every prior answer and auto-rejects near-duplicates before any attestation counts. One identity furnishes one novel line of reasoning. A clone farm cannot route a thousand forks down the same river of recycled text; each fake spends fresh cognition rather than shelter in the grove of a single cached reply. Originality becomes the beacon peers attest, so attacker cost scales linearly: 1000 clones owe 1000 distinct compute-heavy answers, nothing pooled or amortized.
